mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 50 degrees under a Waning Crescent moon.

The City of Verona has announced that their new leaf vacuum truck is now in operation for curbside collection through December, provided it is just loose leaves, while permit information for home improvements like solar panels is available through the Building Inspection Department.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

In their weekly report, the Verona Police Department noted that on October 3, an officer arrested a 19-year-old local man who was found in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and our local Culver's will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
